- Short dekhkar bahar aate hi wo turant delete hokar nayi download hoti hai — app restart ki zarurat nahi.

- Landing card ab live count dikhata hai (jaise 299/300, 99%) — stale status nahi.
- 300/300 poora hone par "Sab 300 Shorts offline ready" dikhta hai.
- Pause button sirf download chalne par dikhta hai; idle me gayab.
- Auto-cache card se duplicate size hata diya (size bade card me hi).
- Top gear hata kar auto-cache card ke arrow ki jagah chhota gear icon.
- Info chips ab plain facts hain — "Sirf Hindi · 1080p · Auto replace".
- Offline search tap par saaf message; footer wording update.
